body.name: Dual-slope multiscale rounding algorithm
body.construction: Given rational \(F\) and an optimal rational table \(q^\star=N\pi^\star\), aggregate repeated atoms, form the optimal-support slope intervals \(I_{as}\), and build the nested partitions \(\mathcal P_{a,\ell}\). From fine to coarse depth, replace the residual table on its current support by a rational basic feasible table with the current integer cluster margins, freeze the integer parts of its cells, and pass the remaining mass upward. Match the selected and required atoms independently along each partition tree and apply the three resulting bijections to the selected rows. Output the resulting \(T_{\mathrm{alg}}\in\mathcal S_N(F)\).
